title.en: Chapter 3 — The Woman Who Was Ahead of Him

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: هولمز تنكر كخوري مجروح وعمل مشكلة قدام بيتها.
sentences.en: Holmes disguised himself as an injured clergyman and staged a scene at her door.

sentences.ar: وأنا رميت دخان من الشباك وصرخت: حريقة!
sentences.en: And I threw smoke through the window and shouted: fire!

sentences.ar: قال لي بعدها: أي واحد بينقذ أغلى إشي عنده الأول.
sentences.en: He said to me afterwards: anyone saves the most precious thing they own first.

sentences.ar: وهي راحت عالصورة من غير ما تفكر.
sentences.en: And she went to the photograph without thinking.
In the morning we returned, and found the house empty.

sentences.ar: كانت تركت مكتوب: عرفت إنك إنت، وسافرت.
sentences.en: She had left a letter: I knew it was you, and I have gone.

sentences.ar: من يومها، هولمز بيسميها المرا، مش باسمها.
sentences.en: From that day, Holmes calls her the woman, not by her name.
